name: led-dot-matrix-text
title: LED Dot Matrix Text
description: Real dot-matrix rendering: a 5×7 bitmap font map draws each character as a grid of glowing dots on canvas — with per-dot bokeh, row scanlines and a scrolling mode that shifts the bitmap like a station display.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Dense
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Monospace
Color: Neon On Dark

## Rules

- Bitmap Scroll: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
